messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT: gpu-pool-hotpath saturation (hotpath-1) — >95% GPU util, queue growth, elevated 429s. page sent to #oncall and #eng-sre.

sara-nguyen: I'm oncall, looking now. seeing queue spike ~19.6k, 429 rate ~37% for tier=standard across us-west-2.

mike-chen: i'm pulling autoscaler logs. autoscaler tried scale up at 2755558800 but AWS returned InsufficientInstanceCapacity, then we hit our targetGroup max of 40.

sara-nguyen: any recent deploys to hotpath-1?

alex-g: no code deploys. infra change — a maintenance job marked 3 GPUs in hotpath-1 as cordoned at 2755556000 (node: hot-1-{a,b,c}). that removed capacity.

jamie-ops: customer impact: CS reports multiple 429s for realtime-chat customers, several dropped sessions. opening incident tracker.

sara-nguyen: timeline TL;DR: maintenance cordoned 3 nodes + InsufficientInstanceCapacity + targetGroup max hit => autoscaler couldn't get past 40, queue grew, token-bucket throttles started returning 429 early.

mike-chen: digging into ratepolicy: tiers set to allow burst=2000 tokens/s for premium, 300 tokens/s for standard, but tokenbucket reserves were mis-allocated: standard had globalReserve=80% in config rollback from last week. that starved routing when under pressure.

alex-g: confirmed. config snippet in prod (sanitized):
```
ratePolicy: 
  tiers:
    - name: premium
      burst: 2000
      reservePct: 10
    - name: standard
      burst: 300
      reservePct: 80
```

jamie-ops: oof. standard gets 80% reserve while premium gets 10% — that's reversed intent. likely propagation from a bad rollout.

sara-nguyen: immediate mitigations: 1) suspend tokenbucket enforcement for standard tier on hotpath-1, 2) open manual scale plan to add nodes, 3) failover lower-latency traffic to coldpool model variant. I'll coordinate.

mike-chen: I can flip the ratepolicy but need to be careful — rollout config is tied to /configs/ratepolicies/hotpath-1. We should do a fast rollback to previous version.

alex-g: also we've got an autoscaler hard cap in ASG policy (max_size=40) pushed by quota change in March. We should request temporary bump from infra to 60 and then scale.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline note: ratepolicy rollback candidate found: revision 2024-06-12-14:02 (previous stable). Ready for manual apply.

sara-nguyen: mike, please apply rollback for ratepolicy (hotpath-1) to revision 2024-06-12-14:02. I'm going to open an emergency scaling request to infra and trigger failover rules.

mike-chen: applying rollback now. patch: `PATCH /configs/ratepolicies/hotpath-1 -> revision 2024-06-12-14:02`

mike-chen: done. ratepolicy rollback applied at 2755559005. moving standard reservePct back to 50 and premium to 30 (we still keep some reserve for other tiers).

sara-nguyen: verify traffic after rollback. logs: standard 429s dropped from 37% -> 12% in last 60s. queue length dropping to ~7.8k.

jamie-ops: sent update to CS and impacted customers: short blip, mitigation in progress, ETA for full recovery 15-20m.

mike-chen: infra responded to scaling request: we have temporary quota bump approved to 55 workers in us-west-2. requesting scale action to target 52.

alex-g: manual scale triggered: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name hotpath-1-asg --desired-capacity 52` executed at 2755559080.

sara-nguyen: monitoring node join: 3 cordoned nodes were uncordoned (hot-1-a, b, c) at 2755559120 too — maintenance rollback in progress.

mike-chen: new nodes booting, but we saw a flurry of backlog processing errors — some worker containers hit OOM due to batched KV cache size increase when we unfroze caches. I'm reducing batch size temporarily.

alex-g: patching runtime config: `KV_CACHE_MAX_BATCH=256 -> 128` across hotpath-1 to ease memory pressure. applying to canary then to all.

sara-nguyen: canary looks good. 429s down to 3%, queue ~900 and shrinking. latencies back to SLO for premium tenants.

jamie-ops: oncall handoff scheduled: sara will stay, jamie will take over next 30m and handle customer comms. paging silence for non-critical alerts enabled on hotpath-1.

sara-nguyen: postmortem action items so far: 1) add preflight check to ratepolicy rollouts that validates reservePct sum/ordering, 2) autoscaler should alert when ASG max==current max_size AND InsufficientInstanceCapacity repeats, 3) remove manual cordon without ticket hook (3 nodes).

mike-chen: adding: 4) add canary flag to ratepolicy rollouts (apply to 1 pool first), 5) add a short term emergency playbook for tokenbucket suspension.

alex-g: I'll open infra ticket to permanently raise hotpath-1 ASG max to 70 and add autoscaler vertical headroom for peak.

deploy-bot: Incident annotation: rollback applied, manual scale executed, maintenance nodes uncordoned, KV batch reduced.

sara-nguyen: final status: degraded -> recovering. still monitoring for 20m. filing incident doc now (incidents/2755558888). thanks team. :thumbsup:

jamie-ops: leaving a short customer-facing blurb for follow-up: "We experienced elevated 429s and request latency due to reduced GPU capacity and a rate-policy rollout mismatch. We mitigated with a config rollback, manual scaling, and runtime tuning. Full postmortem to follow."

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved (status: recovering) at 2755559248.
